hotel.name: Paradisus Playa del Carmen, La Perla

verified_facts.text: The resort is located in a mangrove forest very near large beaches with fine, white sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in an incredible mangrove forest very near huge beaches with fine, white sand, this all-inclusive luxury resort guarantees a truly unique stay.

verified_facts.text: Paradisus Playa del Carmen is an all-inclusive resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in an incredible mangrove forest very near huge beaches with fine, white sand, this all-inclusive luxury resort guarantees a truly unique stay.

verified_facts.text: The resort has direct access to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Direct access to the beach

verified_facts.text: Beaches, coral reefs, cenote pools and Mayan ruins are found in nearby Playa del Carmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beaches, coral reefs, crystal-clear cenote pools and inspiring Mayan ruins await you in nearby Playa del Carmen.

verified_facts.text: The YHI Spa offers body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, essential oils and local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Be pampered with body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, essential oils and local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: An offsite experience offers a yoga class at a Mayan cenote in the jungle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the stunning views of a Mayan cenote located in the heart of the jungle. While you participate in an exclusive yoga class.

verified_facts.text: With the Roulette Room, assignment to either hotel depends on availability and cannot be guaranteed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Assignment to either hotel depends on availability and cannot be guaranteed.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Nature View is a one-bedroom suite with a whirlpool tub on a garden-view terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in this One Bedroom Suite and enjoy the peace and serenity in the whirlpool tub on the terrace with garden views.

verified_facts.text: The Master Suite Nature View has a spacious living room, a dining area and a whirlpool bathtub on a garden-view terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soak up the sun and recharge your batteries in the whirlpool bathtub on your terrace with incredible garden views.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite Nature View has tropical-style furniture and a private terrace with garden views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tropical-style furniture, state-of-the-art technology, and endless extraordinary details. As well as a private terrace with views of the beautiful gardens.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a personalized butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personalized Butler Service

verified_facts.text: The fitness center offers Pilates, yoga, spinning, wellness and massage classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: In addition to Pilates, yoga, spinning, wellness, and massage classes.

verified_facts.text: The resort hosts weddings through Romance by Paradisus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make the wedding of your dreams come true in a resort with a wide range of options. Choose elegance, distinction and lots of love to celebrate the most important event in your life at Paradisus Playa del Carmen.

verified_facts.text: The hotel describes itself as LGBTQ+ friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: This LGTBQ+ friendly hotel in Mexico guarantees a safe and welcoming stay where you can be yourself.

verified_facts.text: Toji, located at Paradisus La Perla, is a Japanese-style bar for sake and creative mixology.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the world of sake and creative mixology at this casual Japanese-style bar. A wide range of drinks that will surprise you with new flavors and aromas. Open only to guests over 18 years of age at Paradisus La Perla.

verified_facts.text: Lemon Fish, located at Paradisus La Perla, serves Latin fusion cuisine with fresh ceviches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a combination of Latin influences, fresh ceviches, and an elegant atmosphere that enhances an unforgettable dining experience. Open only to guests over 18 years of age, located at Paradisus La Perla.

verified_facts.text: Fahrenheit, a pool bar at Paradisus La Perla, serves drinks and grilled snacks.
verified_facts.excerpt: A pool bar where you can enjoy a wide variety of drinks and grilled snacks. Natural, seasonal, and local ingredients will play an important role in this experience. Open only to guests over 18 years old. Located at Paradisus La Perla.

verified_facts.text: M Bar at Paradisus La Perla offers an extensive wine list and innovative martinis.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a drink from an extensive wine list or an exclusive selection of innovative Martinis. A modern Adults Only atmosphere, rich in color and with very comfortable furniture. Open only to guests over 18 years of age at Paradisus La Perla.

verified_facts.text: Kanna Beach Club is a beachfront restaurant with Bali beds on the sand and a DJ on weekends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in Bali beds on soft sand, with a DJ spinning tunes on weekends.

verified_facts.text: Ginger bar serves cocktails with sea and sunset views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serenade yourself with one or more refreshing cocktails while you gaze at the stunning sea and sunset views
